ai_overview.text: The Eiffel Tower is 330 metres (1,083 feet) tall, including its radio antennas. Wikipedia +1 Original Height (1889): 300 metres (984 feet), or about 312 metres including the original flagpole. La tour Eiffel With Current Antennas: 330 metres (1,083 feet), updated when a new radio antenna was added . Wikipedia +1 Floor Heights: 1st floor: 57 metres (187 feet) 2nd floor: 115–125 metres (377–410 feet) 3rd (Top) floor: 276 metres (906 feet) La tour Eiffel +2 Seasonal Variation: The height changes by about 6 inches (15 cm) between summer and winter due to thermal expansion and contraction of the iron.
